artworks.title: Dawn Landscape with Classical Ruins
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a natural and human presence. The viewpoint is slightly elevated. The sky is blue with some clouds. Near us, on the left, people work next to a rocky, green area with waterfalls. There is an ancient-looking stone structure. A small bridge crosses a river with figures and cattle. A tree stands on the right. The scene has rich colors like green, brown, blue, and yellow.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Bearded Man in a Doublet and Skull Cap
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. John Steiner
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man facing forward. He has a full face with a short beard and mustache, curly hair partially covered by a cap, and is wearing a garment with a high collar and vertical or diagonal strokes. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Disputation of Saint Catherine of Alexandria
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowded scene in a classical architectural setting. The drawing shows multiple figures in various poses interacting in a hall or temple. The background includes architectural elements like columns, arches, and a large ceiling with a central hanging element. Figures are dressed in flowing garments and are placed in lively stances, as if engaged in conversation or gathering. The use of shading and line work gives depth to the drawing and enhances the complexity of the composition. Arched beams suggest grandeur, while scattered objects like books indicate a scholarly or philosophical theme.

artworks.title: A Bull on a Ledge
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown-gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bull standing on a small platform. The drawing depicts the bull in profile view, facing left, displaying its strong body and curved horns. The bull's tail is raised, adding a sense of motion to the static pose. The artist has used ink to create strong lines and washes to give depth and texture to the bull's musculature and the ground beneath its hooves. The paper is slightly aged, with some visible stains, giving the piece an antique appearance. The ground beneath the bull is rendered in a darker tone, distinguishing it from the lighter background, highlighting the animal's prominence in the drawing.

artworks.title: Christ in Half-Length
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David Tunick in honor of Charles Parkhurst
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length engraving of a man's upper body. The man has long, wavy hair and a full beard. He wears a draped garment, possibly a robe, with detailed folds. His head is turned slightly to the right, gazing upwards. The man's right hand is raised in a gesture. The background is plain, highlighting the engraving's lines and details. At the bottom is an inscription in Latin: "ADORATE DOMINVM OMNES SANCTI EIVS," accompanied by names, presumably of the artist and engraver.

artworks.title: The Death of the Miser
artworks.artist: William Henry Brooke after Hieronymus Bosch

artworks.title: Catalogo delle Opere Date Finora Alla Lvce Da Gio Battista Piranesi
artworks.artist: Giovanni Battista Piranesi and Francesco Piranesi (authors)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a catalog featuring works by Giovanni Battista Piranesi. The drawing includes text boxes with a catalog of architectural works and illustrations of Roman structures and artifacts. The text is promotional material for a collection of prints showcasing Rome's ancient landmarks, with titles in Italian. Ornamental elements like architectural motifs, classical columns, and decorative patterns fill the space. The bottom of the drawing has an illustration of a panoramic view of the Vatican and St. Peter's Basilica surrounded by ancient Roman buildings. The drawing contains detailed engravings showing architectural features and ancient ruins, reflecting Piranesi's style known for highlighting the grandeur and historical richness of Roman architecture.

artworks.title: Catalogo delle Opere Date Finora Alla Lvce Da Gio Battista Piranesi
artworks.artist: Giovanni Battista Piranesi and Francesco Piranesi (authors)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a detailed catalog or listing of artworks by Giovanni Battista Piranesi, featuring text and illustrations organized into sections such as "Antichità Romane" and "Vedute di Roma" discussing Roman architecture and views of Rome. The images show smaller drawings of architectural elements, monuments, and vistas, with two notable illustrations at the bottom showcasing elaborate settings with classical elements and intricate details in Piranesi's style.

artworks.title: Fountain in a Courtyard
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink and watercolor over graphite on laid paper; graphite and brown ink sketches on verso
artworks.description: The image portrays an architectural ruin with a view of vertical elements such as a classical column and an arch. A statue is visible in a niche on the left. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing the intricacies of the column and flowing water from a fountain. The color palette includes earthy browns, grays, subtle greens, and pale blue-gray. Water in the fountain is depicted with whites and blues. The scene conveys textures of aged stone and flowing water.

artworks.title: L'Ordre Corinthian
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink and gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural column detail. The drawing showcases the intricate design of a Corinthian column capital, featuring acanthus leaves and volutes typical of this classical style. The upper portion includes the entablature with detailed measurements noted on the sides. The shading and line work emphasize precision and detail, focusing on the decorative and structural elements of the Corinthian order.

artworks.title: The Round Temple on the Piazza Bocca della Verità, Rome
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a round, classical-style building with columns. The horizon is placed towards the top of the image, with other structures such as rooftops and a distant tower visible against it. The sketch features bold brushstrokes emphasizing the outlines of the architecture and landscape. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by black and white contrasts. A small human figure gestures outward in the foreground, with the building positioned beyond it.

artworks.title: Ruins of the Imperial Palaces on the Palatine Hill
artworks.description: The image captures an expansive scene from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is high, distinguished by the outline of tree tops and structures in the distance. The illustration depicts architectural forms and buildings with distinct rooftops, including a structure with archways and columns. Loose, textured brushstrokes give the image a sketch-like quality. The palette is black and white, focusing on contrast and composition. Close vegetation and water lead the eye towards the built environment with varied heights and architectural details, set against a backdrop of trees and sky.

artworks.title: A Roman Street with Monte Cavo in the Distance
artworks.description: The image shows a street with architectural elements, a statue on the left, and mountains in the background. The drawing uses fine lines and cross-hatching for shading. It is in black and white with varying shades of gray. Buildings with arched windows line the street, leading to an archway in the distance. Birds are lightly sketched in the sky.

artworks.title: Landscape with the Church of San Teodoro
artworks.description: This drawing depicts structures and landscape. The horizon line is indicated by trees and rooftops near the upper third. The brushstrokes are finely sketched with cross-hatching for texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing light and shadow with black, white, and grays. The composition includes a simple landscape with boats or wooden structures, a central rotunda-like building with a conical roof, trees, and tall trees in the distance. On the far right, part of another building is visible for architectural balance.

artworks.title: Walls of Rome with Santa Maria del Popolo in the Distance
artworks.description: This image displays a landscape sketch with an architectural setting. It features an implied horizon with trees and buildings blending into the distance. A large domed structure stands out among the rooftops. The sketch is composed of pencil strokes, emphasizing texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray to define structures and nature. In the foreground, a bridge or aqueduct with archways is visible, along with figures and an animal.

artworks.title: Arched Passageways of a Ruined Building
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of an architectural ruin viewed from a slightly elevated point. It shows a series of arches extending into space, with a horizon line that is not distinct but suggests depth as the arches recede into the distance. The sketch uses short pencil strokes to depict stone surfaces and foliage, with contrast created through light and shadow. The color palette is primarily shades of gray. Larger arches are closer, with smaller arches and sketched trees in the background. Additional structures can be seen behind the main ruin.

artworks.title: An Ancient Wall with a Ruined Gate
artworks.description: The image is a monochromatic sketch of a natural landscape from an elevated point of view. The composition lacks a defined horizon, creating a sense of continuity. The sketch depicts trees and rocky formations with varying density using expressive brushstrokes. The color palette is solely black on a white background. Close to the viewer are rough terrains and pathways, while in the distance are loosely defined vegetation and open sky or cleared spaces.

artworks.title: View across the Wall of an Italian Garden
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch featuring a stone wall with a spherical ornament, architectural structures, tall trees, and mountains in the background. The sketch is rendered in monochrome, using shades of gray to create light and shadow.

artworks.title: Arch of Drusus near the Appian Way
artworks.description: The image shows a stone archway from an eye-level perspective. The drawing features loose graphite lines, detailing brickwork and vegetation on the structure. A fence with decorative elements is on the left, and a path leads away between the archway and a wall on the right. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray for depth and contrast.

artworks.title: Ruins of the Temple of Venus and Rome in the Forum
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of an architectural structure seen from a slightly elevated perspective. The drawing depicts an ancient building with a central arched feature and a tower rising above it. The technique used involves delicate pencil lines, cross-hatching, and shading to convey texture and details. The color palette is monochromatic, using varying tones of graphite on off-white paper to create depth. The ground close to the viewer appears to have more defined shadows, while lighter pencil strokes suggest foliage or rubble. Soft strokes indicate trees or shrubs in the distance. The focus on line work highlights the architectural form and the artist's skill in capturing the structure.

artworks.title: Villa d'Este, Tivoli
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a grand building, viewed from a side angle. The perspective suggests an elevated position, looking across a terrace or slope towards the building. The architectural details like arches and parapets are depicted with precise pencil strokes. Large trees frame the scene on the left and right sides, while the foreground features dense foliage suggesting a garden or woodland. The background is kept simple to highlight the main structure. The image is rendered in grayscale to emphasize contrast and texture.

artworks.title: Casino Farnese on the Palatine Hill, Rome
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of an architectural scene. The horizon is high, with birds in the sky. There is a pathway leading towards buildings on elevated ground. The drawing has delicate and varied brushstrokes, creating texture in the landscape. Trees and bushes are depicted with loose strokes. The buildings in the distance have straight lines and subtle detailing, with one larger structure. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of grey, created with pencil.

artworks.title: Roman Ruins with a Stand of Cypresses
artworks.description: The image is a sketch depicting ancient ruins with trees. The perspective is straightforward, showing a scene where the ruins and trees rise above the horizon. The drawing uses varied pencil strokes to capture textures of the stone structures and foliage, with an emphasis on light and shadow contrasts. The color palette is limited to black, white, and shades of gray, giving a monochromatic feel. Elements include remnants of the structures' bases, vegetation, a larger ruin with an arch, and tall, slender trees.

artworks.title: Roman Walls
artworks.description: The image depicts a series of arched structures with a sketchy style. The drawing has loose and light pencil strokes outlining the contours and textures of the scene. The arches are defined with darker lines and shading is done with cross-hatching in shades of gray. The foreground shows rough terrain or fallen debris, while in the distance there is faint shading hinting at more structures.
